389 object claims from imagined held-out views, 20 scenes. Intervals: 95%, 2,000 scene-level bootstrap resamples. Recall at a false-flag rate: the best recall among thresholds that flag at most that share of real objects (chosen per resample). Best F1 over thresholds: threshold fitted on each resample, optimistic for every method.

Sanity check: the greedy yes/no answers match `p_no > 0.5` for 100.0% of self-check calls and 99.7% of calls with observed frames.
